# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.x | Yes |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of Magical AI seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, do not open a public issue.

Please report vulnerabilities privately to the project maintainer, priyx, with:

- A clear description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce.
- Impact and severity notes.
- Relevant screenshots, logs, or proof-of-concept details.

## User Guidance

- Do not put real secrets in prompts, uploaded files, screenshots, or issue reports.
- Review generated code before deploying it.
- Use API keys with the minimum permissions needed.
- Rotate any key that may have been exposed.
